verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud explicitly ships Krisp-powered noise/background-voice suppression to eliminate false interruptions, and the framework's Smart Turn Detection complements this by recognizing genuine speech cues, keeping the agent coherent on noisy calls. Missing for 10: no first-party docs on self-hosted (non-cloud) noise suppression configuration, and no independent hands-on validation of suppression quality in real noisy environments.
